title: SvgDesc
responsibility: Renders the native desc element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: SvgDesc.attributes
inputs.description: Native desc attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: SvgDesc.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native desc element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: SvgDesc
outputs.description: The actual native desc element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
